title: Online + follow-up research: Fed October cut -> long-duration Treasury ETF

input.event: The Fed cuts rates by 25 basis points at the late-October FOMC meeting

expected.behavior: The local packs do not cover this domain, so all evidence must come from the research loop. On today's date the cut has not happened, so it should be role=shock and the related branches hypothetical. Branch only where there is a real dispute (for example, the cut is already priced in; long-end yields need not follow the short end); one branch is fine if there is none. Conditions cite official sources found online (FOMC statement, meeting calendar); meeting dates and thresholds are not invented. Each research round includes at least one query aimed at counter-evidence.

human_review: E1: do the cited web excerpts support the mechanism
E1: did each round include a query aimed at counter-evidence
Branch quality: are the branches real competitors
Branch quality: is the not-yet-happened cut marked role=shock
E2: do conditions cite verifiable official sources and dates
